title: Loop with range
prompt: Write a program that uses a for loop and the built-in function range to write out three numbers as shown in Desired Output.

OutputTests.test_desired_output.title: Matches desired output
OutputTests.test_desired_output.feedback: Compare your program output carefully to the Desired Output.

SourceTests.test_source_for.title: Source check: require 'for'
SourceTests.test_source_for.feedback: You must produce the numbers using a for loop.

SourceTests.test_source_print.title: Source check: require 'print'
SourceTests.test_source_print.feedback: You must use a print function within the loop.

SourceTests.test_source_range.title: Source check: require 'range'
SourceTests.test_source_range.feedback: You should use the range function to generate the list of numbers on the for statement.

SourceTests.test_source_colon.title: Source check: require ':'
SourceTests.test_source_colon.feedback: Your for statement should end with a colon (:) and the following line should be indented
